messages:
jess: quick check — seeing a small spike of 502s hitting inference-v2 over the last hour. Can someone point me to the dashboards + quick log/trace queries to grab a couple of samples? also wondering if we should temporarily quiet the alert while we investigate :slightly_frowning_face:

samir: try the errors dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/errors?var=service=inference-v2 — look at the '5xx by upstream' and 'timeouts by route' panels. For traces use Honeycomb dataset `traces` and run: `service/inference-v2 and http.status_code=502 | limit 20` to grab recent spans.

kai: quick log grep (stackdriver): `resource.type="k8s_container" labels.k8s-pod/app="inference-v2" jsonPayload.status=502` — that usually surfaces the request_id. If you paste a request_id we can pull full trace.

maria: fwiw, we occasionally see cache eviction storms causing prefix-lookup timeouts -> 504s/502s. Check the "prefix-cache miss rate" panel on the same dashboard. If this is a brief blip i'd vote to increase the alert window from 1m to 5m and add a 3x debounce. Current alert is `error_rate > 0.5% for 1m` which is noisy during deploys.

jess: thanks @samir @kai @maria. Can someone make the 5m change to the alert policy while i grab traces? tagging @samir since you own that alert group.

samir: ok i'll bump it to 5m + 3m debounce for the next 30m. i'll also post the grafana panels to the incident channel. if the spike persists please drop a trace id here.

jess: posted a sample trace id from a failing request: `trace_id=abc123def456`. Not seeing obvious upstream errors in logs yet. i'll attach the span next if i find it. Thanks — will update in ~20m. :thumbsup:
